name: SHIMS Channel Bridge
description: Relays inbound channel messages (WhatsApp) from OpenClaw into the SHIMS Omni backend.

shimsUrl.description: SHIMS Omni backend base URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8010).

bridgeToken.description: Must equal SHIMS_BRIDGE_TOKEN on the SHIMS server. The relay fails closed without it.

relayGroups.description: Relay group messages as well as direct messages. Default false.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for the relay POST (default 8000).
